relationships.subject: rostral ACC
relationships.evidence_quote: the rostral ACC exerts a negative modulatory effect on itch, whereas the caudal ACC plays a positive modulatory role

relationships.subject: caudal ACC
relationships.evidence_quote: inhibition of the caudal ACC reduced both 5-HT- and Compound 48/80-induced acute itch-scratching behavior

key_findings: Rostral ACC negatively and caudal ACC positively modulate itch.
Only caudal ACC modulates histaminergic itch.
